name: pixelagents
description: Observes Discord guild presence, answers Pixelpipes editor authorization checks, and manages saved layouts through the standalone Pixelpipes producer WebSocket.
end_user_data_statement: This cog transmits Discord user IDs, guild IDs, display names, presence status, and short message activity snippets to the configured Pixelpipes producer WebSocket. It stores saved Pixelpipes layout JSON per Discord user.
install_msg: Configure the producer WebSocket with `[p]pixelagents producerurl` if needed, set `[p]pixelagents editorrole`, then enable a guild with `[p]pixelagents enable`.
author: Tin Nguyen
